composio.note: Composio has no managed OAuth app for SurveyMonkey; create an auth config with your own client ID and secret.

need_own_app.answer: Yes. Composio lists SurveyMonkey as bring-your-own OAuth app, so you must register your own app and supply its client ID and secret.

Users see your app name instead of Composio

prerequisites.title: Paid SurveyMonkey plan
prerequisites.detail: Creating and deploying an OAuth app requires a paid plan. Private app users also need a paid plan with API access.

prerequisites.title: Privacy policy and terms of use
prerequisites.detail: Your app must include a privacy policy and its own terms of use.

prerequisites.title: Unrestricted use case
prerequisites.detail: Apps must relate to facilitating surveys and must not replicate SurveyMonkey's core features. Check this before building.

steps.title: Register a draft app
steps.detail: Sign in at the Developer Portal with a paid account and add a new app.
steps.done_when: Draft app exists with a client ID.

steps.title: Copy redirect URI from Composio
steps.detail: Get the callback URL from the Composio dashboard and prepare it for the app's OAuth Redirect URL.

steps.title: Set redirect URL and scopes
steps.detail: On the SETTINGS tab, enter the redirect URL and set needed scopes to required or optional.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create an auth config for survey_monkey with your client ID and secret, copied from the OVERVIEW tab.

steps.title: Deploy as Private app
steps.detail: Click Deploy and choose Private before the 90-day draft ends.

steps.title: Draft app listing and justifications
steps.detail: Write an honest English listing covering functionality and scope requirements, with support and privacy details.

steps.title: Submit listing for approval
steps.detail: Use the listings tab in My Apps to submit.

traps.title: SurveyMonkey permits three violations of up to 150% within
traps.detail: SurveyMonkey permits three violations of up to 150% within a 30-day window before enforcing limits at 100%.

traps.title: Draft app is disabled after 90 days
traps.detail: Deploy before the window ends or the app is disabled. An extension can be requested through the help center.

traps.title: AI use of API content is barred
traps.detail: The terms bar using API content to develop or improve AI or machine learning systems. Confirm that your agent's use fits.

traps.title: Two scopes need separate approval
traps.detail: Create/Modify Responses and Create/Modify Surveys need SurveyMonkey approval in a public app.

traps.title: Rejection can happen on unlisted criteria
traps.detail: SurveyMonkey can reject an app on criteria not in the checklist, and approval does not guarantee compliance.

traps.title: Private app users must share a team
traps.detail: Every user must be on the same paid SurveyMonkey team, so private apps cannot serve outside customers.

traps.title: Basic plans cap response details
traps.detail: Basic plan accounts can see details for only 25 responses per survey.

blockers.symptom: Another organization's account cannot authorize your app
blockers.what_it_means: Draft and private apps cannot be used by outside accounts.
blockers.what_to_do: Deploy as a Public app and pass review.
blockers.agent_can_help: Prepare the listing and scope justifications.

blockers.what_it_means: Draft and private apps start at 120 calls/minute and from 500 calls/day.
blockers.what_to_do: Contact sales; requests for limit increases are reviewed within 5 business days.

open_questions: How long does public app review take? Ask SurveyMonkey developer support via the help center.
Which exact plan does the developer account need to deploy? The public page shows no plan; check the account in the Developer Portal.
Does the AI training ban affect an agent that reads survey data? Ask SurveyMonkey, or check the terms.
